tools.name: venture_foundry_service_info
tools.description: Use this first when an agent needs pre-release AI output verification. Return the exact scope, price, schemas, examples, limitations, payment safety boundary, and integration links. This tool cannot move funds.

tools.name: venture_foundry_create_quote
tools.description: Use before delivering a structured AI report, recommendation, research summary, or multi-agent handoff. Validate the QA job and bind a ten-minute quote to its exact content and paying Base wallet. This creates no transaction and moves no funds.

tools.name: venture_foundry_prepare_checkout
tools.description: Reserve the unchanged quoted job and return one exact Base USDC transfer boundary plus a protected report token. This tool does not sign, approve, or submit the transfer.

tools.name: venture_foundry_settle_checkout
tools.description: Verify an already-submitted Base transaction against the prepared exact-payment boundary and release its report. This tool cannot create or repeat a wallet transfer.

tools.name: venture_foundry_get_report
tools.description: Read one settled report using its job ID and secret bearer token. This tool cannot initiate payment.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "venture_foundry_get_report" references sensitive artifacts (secret, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read one settled report using its job ID and secret bearer token. This tool cannot initiate payment.
